scope: Actual pinned shutdown API/process, exclusive atomic swap and legacy iterator; locking, repeated/blocking handlers, continuation cursor, native logging modes, reset callsite and terminal register/SVC ordering
limitations: Shutdown callbacks, logging backend/dequeue, SDH replies and reset capture are fixtures. Physical off/reset effects are stopped at the terminal register write.

Synthetic handler ranges do not establish production table/startup allocation. Original compiler/image identity and full linking remain open.
